title: Depth Information from Backscattered Scanning Electron Microscope Images Using Multiple Beam Energies and Parameter Estimation Methods
content: Backscattered electron images (BSE) in the scanning electron microscope (SEM) are affected by intensity ambiguities created by shine-through effects from sub-surface sample structures. The impact of the shine -through effect in porous samples is proportional to the energy of the beam (fig. 1).
